source_record.name: alternate heel touchers
source_record.description: Lying on your back, you crunch sideways to reach each hand toward its heel in turn. Works the obliques and abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulders off the ground and reach your right hand towards your right heel.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the left side, reaching your left hand towards your left heel.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

source_cue_resolution: Five-second controlled alternating lateral heel reach, feet flat and knees bent. Source wording "arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground" is interpreted as straight arms hovering alongside the torso toward the feet, with a small relaxed elbow bend. Each same-side reach is led by lateral upper-trunk flexion; hands approach the actual heel/Achilles-heel skin, without a wide T-pose arm sweep. The return closes the loop. Numerical timing, stance and range are authored illustration choices.
